extracted.intended_audience: students and general readers of 19th-century European military and political history
extracted.subtask_description: A narrative account of military campaigns (here, the Franco-Prussian War of 1870–71) focusing on causes, strategic dispositions, battlefield actions, leadership, morale, and outcomes; useful as an example for composing detailed historical prose about warfare. Emphasizes sequence, explanation of decisions, and vivid descriptive detail of places and actions.
